dialog.sign-digital-id.note: printcraft sign_ui/dialog.rs: Choose ID, Configure and Sign as are steps drawn by the dialog; Back and Continue are footer buttons (with Sign and Cancel, one row) that ask the dialog to move.

dialog.certificate-viewer.note: printcraft sign_ui/panel.rs cert_viewer: the chain on the left, Summary, Details and Trust on the right, and Acrobat's Revocation, Policies and Legal Notice tabs saying what this viewer does not do; Export… is the dialog's own button.
